question: With the same model, endpoint and effort, what does playing under the pi coding-agent CLI instead of the wrathbench loop change in the progress, the stalls and the tokens sent per call of six hours of play?
note: The pi probe campaign (operator, 2026-10-20: wrathbench stays the reference harness, harnesses plug into one seam, and the reference changes only if a probe campaign says to). The harness is chosen by the assignment, not the arm: the definition has one arm, and the store row assigns two roster entries for the same model id, deepseek-flash on the DeepSeek platform (api.deepseek.com), one on the openai driver (the wrathbench harness) and one on the pi driver, so the model and the endpoint are shared and the model already has a wrathbench history (operator, 2026-10-20). Both entries name thinking effort high, because pi asks for high on deepseek-flash when no effort is set while the openai driver then sends no level at all (operator, 2026-10-20). The arm runs the release build harness-0.5-1587-g66cd7749, pinned by digest, so both assignments run one build, the pi 1.3.0 it carries included; a pinned arm runs only in a run pod. pi compacts at a fixed 300k-token window (operator, 2026-10-20), stamped as a run dimension: it is the pi entry's compactWindow and not an arm argument, because an arm's --compact-window would be refused for both assignments (the openai driver has no compaction window, and the pi entry already sets one). pi 1.3.0's catalogue gives deepseek-flash a 1,000,000-token window, so 300k binds: it reaches pi as reserveTokens 700000 and pi compacts above 300,000 tokens, where its own threshold would be 983,616. The same reserve caps the summary pi asks for, which 300k lifts from about 13k tokens to the model's 384k output cap, a ceiling and not a length; tying the cap to the reserve is accepted (operator, 2026-10-20). wrathbench compacts nothing; its trim-and-fold window is its context policy. pi's own model-facing text (the notice on an MCP result cut at 20 KB, the re-issue text after a reply hits its output cap, and the framing of a compaction summary) is stock and part of what the pi label means, not patched (operator, 2026-10-20). The clock is e360's six hours (operator, 2026-10-23), so that pi's context can grow past its 300k window and the comparison includes pi compacting, which ninety minutes might never reach. The leash is e360's: idle 20 minutes, the no-XP watchdog off as in every definition so far, and the 12000-call guard. No level ends a run, so the clock is the end. resume is false: a resumed pi run starts a fresh pi with none of its history, a compaction to nothing that no window chose, and a scored episode never resumes either; a paused run is a spent attempt and the next starts fresh. One cell, human-paladin, the start this model's scored runs under the wrathbench harness were played from. The comparison is the two assignments' squares inside this campaign; those earlier runs are context only, at whatever effort they ran. Version 2 supersedes pi-vs-wrathbench@1, which was never started: it changes only the clock and the call guard, from e90's to e360's; the arm, the build, the cell and the assignments are version 1's.
